description:
The brand's Fixes list: the one-time technical, schema and listing fixes
    that make the site readable and citable by AI engines, highest impact
    first, each found by our own crawl and scan. The same list as the Fixes page.
    Work through them with the user, then call mark_fix when one is done; the
    next scan checks it. Content to write is not a Fix: see list_content.
